mapper.sql: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class visible_class JOIN capacity_course visible_course ON visible_course.id = h.course_id AND visible_course.deleted = 0 AND visible_course.status = 0 JOIN edu_class_course visible_binding ON visible_binding.class_id = h.class_id AND visible_binding.course_id = h.course_id AND visible_binding.deleted = 0 AND visible_binding.status = 0 WHERE visible_class.id = h.class_id AND visible_class.deleted = 0 AND visible_class.status = 0 AND (TRIM(COALESCE(h.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(visible_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(visible_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(h.semester_name)))
AND (h.status IN (1, 2) OR (h.status = 3 AND hr.id IS NOT NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT class_id FROM edu_class_student WHERE deleted = 0 AND student_id = #{studentId} AND class_id IN (SELECT id FROM edu_class WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0)

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_image_url AS coverUrl, c.course_introduction AS description, c.teacher_Id AS teacherId, teacher.nickname AS teacherName, c.indicator_id AS indicatorId, indicator.indicator_name AS indicatorName FROM capacity_course c LEFT JOIN system_users teacher ON teacher.id = c.teacher_Id AND teacher.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN capacity_indicator indicator ON indicator.id = c.indicator_id AND indicator.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 0

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM edu_homework h INNER JOIN edu_homework_assignee ha ON ha.homework_id = h.id AND ha.student_id = #{studentId} AND ha.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = h.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN edu_homework_record hr ON hr.homework_id = h.id AND hr.student_id = #{studentId} AND hr.deleted = 0 WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} AND h.deleted = 0
)

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_student cs INNER JOIN edu_class_course cc ON cc.class_id = cs.class_id AND cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND cc.deleted = 0 AND cc.status = 0 INNER JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cc.class_id AND ec.deleted = 0 AND ec.status = 0 INNER JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = cc.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 0 WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.deleted = 0 )

SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, h.homework_name AS homeworkName, h.homework_type AS homeworkType, h.homework_level AS homeworkLevel, h.deadline, COALESCE(hr.status, 0) AS status, h.score FROM edu_homework h INNER JOIN edu_homework_assignee ha ON ha.homework_id = h.id AND ha.student_id = #{studentId} AND ha.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN edu_homework_record hr ON hr.homework_id = h.id AND hr.student_id = #{studentId} AND hr.deleted = 0 WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} AND h.deleted = 0
ORDER BY h.id DESC

SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, h.homework_level AS homeworkLevel, COALESCE(h.indicator_first_id, 0) AS indicatorFirstId, ci.indicator_name AS indicatorName, h.deadline AS deadline, h.pass_score AS passScore, h.score AS fullScore, (SELECT MAX(ext.deadline) FROM edu_homework_extension ext WHERE ext.homework_id = h.id AND ext.student_id = #{studentId} AND ext.deleted = 0) AS personalDeadline, hr.id AS recordId, hr.status AS recordStatus, hr.redo_deadline AS redoDeadline, hr.score AS recordScore, (SELECT hh.score FROM edu_homework_record_history hh WHERE hh.record_id = hr.id AND hh.deleted = 0 AND hh.event_type IN ('CORRECT', 'GRADEBOOK_IMPORT') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_homework_grading_action ga WHERE ga.record_id = hr.id AND ga.history_id = hh.id AND ga.notify_status = 2 AND ga.deleted = 0) ORDER BY hh.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastCorrectScore FROM edu_homework h INNER JOIN edu_homework_assignee ha ON ha.homework_id = h.id AND ha.student_id = #{studentId} AND ha.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN edu_homework_record hr ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND hr.student_id = #{studentId} AND hr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN capacity_indicator ci ON ci.id = h.indicator_first_id AND ci.deleted = 0 WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} AND h.homework_level IN (1, 2, 3) AND h.deleted = 0
ORDER BY h.homework_level, h.id

SELECT COALESCE(h.indicator_first_id, 0) AS indicatorFirstId, h.homework_level AS homeworkLevel, COUNT(*) AS taskCount FROM edu_homework h WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} AND h.homework_level IN (1, 2, 3) AND h.status IN (1, 2) AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.class_id IN (SELECT cs.class_id FROM edu_class_student cs WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.deleted = 0)
GROUP BY COALESCE(h.indicator_first_id, 0), h.homework_level

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalHomework, SUM(CASE WHEN hr.status = 2 AND hr.score >= h.pass_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedHomework, AVG(CASE WHEN hr.score IS NOT NULL THEN hr.score END) AS avgScore FROM edu_homework h INNER JOIN edu_homework_assignee ha ON ha.homework_id = h.id AND ha.student_id = #{studentId} AND ha.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN edu_homework_record hr ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND hr.student_id = #{studentId} AND hr.deleted = 0 WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} AND h.deleted = 0
